newsitem.title: USA: Minn. Gov. believes bonds likely for flood costs.
newsitem.headline: Minn. Gov. believes bonds likely for flood costs.

text.p: Minnesota Gov. Arne Carlson believes it may be necessary to issue bonds for flood damage repairs, a spokesman said Thursday.

Carlson has talked about the possibility of issuing debt for flood repairs and is also considering the possibility of a special legislative session in August or September once the amount of damage and financial need is known, Brian Dietz said.

"I'd say it's too early to know which way it will go," Dietz said. "But it's likely that either in a special session later this summer or fall or next year that there will be some sort of bonding money for flood repairs."
